Hops#

This page lists every hop Booster knows; the list is generated from the hop data by the docs build.

Hop Kind From To What it does
php-55-to-56 php 5.5 5.6 Move PHP 5.5 code to PHP 5.6.
php-56-to-70 php 5.6 7.0 Move PHP 5.6 code to PHP 7.0.
php-70-to-71 php 7.0 7.1 Move PHP 7.0 code to PHP 7.1.
php-71-to-72 php 7.1 7.2 Move PHP 7.1 code to PHP 7.2.
php-72-to-73 php 7.2 7.3 Move PHP 7.2 code to PHP 7.3.
php-73-to-74 php 7.3 7.4 Move PHP 7.3 code to PHP 7.4.
php-74-to-80 php 7.4 8.0 Move PHP 7.4 code to PHP 8.0.
php-80-to-81 php 8.0 8.1 Move PHP 8.0 code to PHP 8.1.
php-81-to-82 php 8.1 8.2 Move PHP 8.1 code to PHP 8.2.
php-82-to-83 php 8.2 8.3 Move PHP 8.2 code to PHP 8.3.
php-83-to-84 php 8.3 8.4 Move PHP 8.3 code to PHP 8.4.
php-84-to-85 php 8.4 8.5 Move PHP 8.4 code to PHP 8.5.
laravel-5.8-to-6 laravel 5.8 6 Move a Laravel 5.8 app to Laravel 6.
laravel-6-to-7 laravel 6 7 Move a Laravel 6 app to Laravel 7.
laravel-7-to-8 laravel 7 8 Move a Laravel 7 app to Laravel 8.
laravel-8-to-9 laravel 8 9 Move a Laravel 8 app to Laravel 9.
laravel-9-to-10 laravel 9 10 Move a Laravel 9 app to Laravel 10.
laravel-10-to-11 laravel 10 11 Move a Laravel 10 app to Laravel 11.
laravel-11-to-12 laravel 11 12 Move a Laravel 11 app to Laravel 12.
laravel-12-to-13 laravel 12 13 Move a Laravel 12 app to Laravel 13.
phpunit-9-to-10 phpunit 9 10 Move PHPUnit 9 tests to PHPUnit 10.
phpunit-10-to-11 phpunit 10 11 Move PHPUnit 10 tests to PHPUnit 11.
phpunit-11-to-12 phpunit 11 12 Move PHPUnit 11 tests to PHPUnit 12.
phpunit-12-to-13 phpunit 12 13 Move PHPUnit 12 tests to PHPUnit 13.
phpunit-to-9-manual phpunit below-9 9 Move PHPUnit to ^9 by hand: PHPUnit below 9 does not run on PHP 8, so later gates cannot run until it moves.
cas-to-sesame sesame wayne-cas sesame Swap the wayne-cas package for SESAME native names: ModelUserResolver, auth.sesame, and the app's own ReadOnlyAttributes.
wayneui-1-to-2 wayneui 1 2 Move WayneUI 1.x (Bootstrap 3) to 2.x (wsu- classes): rewrites the one-to-one items and lists the rest.
vendored-to-composer framework hand-copied composer Move hand-copied Doctrine 2, Smarty 3 and Slim 1 out of vendor/ and onto their maintained Composer releases (doctrine/orm 2.20, smarty/smarty 4.5, slim/slim 4 through a Slim 1 bridge).
cakephp-4-to-4.6 framework 4 4.6 Move a CakePHP 4 app to the last 4.x release (4.6) with CakePHP's own upgrade rules, so every deprecation is flagged before the jump to 5.
cakephp-4.6-to-5 framework 4.6 5.4 Move a CakePHP 4.6 app to CakePHP 5.4 with CakePHP's own upgrade rules: AuthComponent moves to the Authentication plugin and .ctp templates become .php.
slim-3-to-4 framework 3 4.15 Move a Slim 3 app to Slim 4.15: the app factory, PSR-7 through slim/psr7, Slim's ErrorMiddleware, and a double-pass adapter so the app's middleware keeps working.
session-strict-mode session off strict Turn on strict session IDs in a raw PHP app: set session.use_strict_mode and session.use_only_cookies before each session_start() call.
cakephp-to-laravel strangler cakephp-5 laravel-13 Move a CakePHP 5 app onto Laravel 13 one unit at a time: sign-in on SESAME first, then Laravel at the root with the old app in legacy/, then routes and forms move run by run, each one gated by the replay.
slim-to-laravel strangler slim-4 laravel-13 Move a Slim 4 app onto Laravel 13 one unit at a time: sign-in on SESAME first, then Laravel at the root with the old app in legacy/, then routes and forms move run by run, each one gated by the replay.
node-pin-24 node any 26 Pin the app to Node 26: set engines.node in package.json and write .nvmrc.
mix-to-vite node laravel-mix vite Move a simple Laravel Mix front end to Vite (simple webpack.mix.js files only).
vite-major node any 8 Move a Vite front end onto Vite 8: pin vite and the Laravel and Vue plugin packages to the data versions.
tailwind-3-to-4 node 3 4 Move a Tailwind CSS 3 front end to Tailwind CSS 4 with the official upgrade tool.
typescript-major node any 6 Move the app to TypeScript 6: pin typescript in package.json, and vue-tsc too when the app has it.
vue-26-to-27 node 2.6 2.7 Move a Vue 2.6 front end to Vue 2.7, the last Vue 2 release, which carries the Vue 3 reactivity API.
vue-27-to-compat node 2.7 3 Move a Vue 2.7 front end to Vue 3 through the @vue/compat build.
vue-compat-codemod node 3-compat 3 Run the vue-upgrade-tool codemod over the front end and keep every manual item it lists.
vue-2-to-3 vue 2 3 Move a Vue 2 front end to Vue 3 (playbook only; Rector does not read Vue).
inertia-2-to-3 node 2 3 Move an Inertia 2 app to Inertia 3: pin inertiajs/inertia-laravel to ^3.0 and @inertiajs/vue3 to ^3.0.

The hop id node-pin-24 is a stable id. The table shows the hop data's target (26); an app's plan pins the Node its Citadel image ships, or the major --node names, and the plan's step line says which (node-pin-24 (pins Node 22)). Its gate builds the front end on that Node (npm ci, npm run build) when package.json has a build script and a lock, then runs the app's tests.

Every other hop lifts the engine; wayneui-1-to-2 is the one that repaints the bodywork.

vendored-to-composer is the first framework hop, planned only with --vendored. It moves hand-copied Doctrine 2, Smarty 3 and Slim 1 under the app root's vendor/ onto doctrine/orm ^2.20, smarty/smarty ^4.5 and slim/slim ^4.15 (through the Slim 1 bridge it writes), at the first PHP every one of those runs on: 7.4 with Slim, 7.1 without. Its recipes and stop signs live in code (VendoredMigration), not in the hop data, and a stop sign leaves it out of the plan with the file and line. Hand-copied libraries to Composer has the details.

Booster plans any target the policy knows. A target past security support is allowed as a stop on the way up, with a plan warning that names the date its security support ended. A version the policy does not list at all is still refused by name.

A Laravel major hop also raises the companion packages its target major pairs with (for Laravel 13, laravel/tinker to ^3.0), but only where the app already lists them in require or require-dev; absent packages are never added, and a constraint that already floors at or above the pin's floor is left alone.

A PHPUnit major hop does the same for Pest, whose majors pair one to one with PHPUnit's: PHPUnit 10, 11, 12 and 13 take pestphp/pest and pestphp/pest-plugin-laravel to ^2.0, ^3.0, ^4.0 and ^5.0, again only where the app lists them. Other Pest plugins are not raised; when one holds the old Pest back, Composer's answer in the gate names it.

A PHPUnit hop's composer update -W also names every locked package that leans on PHPUnit or its parts (one that requires phpunit/phpunit or a package PHPUnit pulls in, such as phpspec/prophecy, or one whose conflict rules out the new major, such as a PHPStan extension), because -W moves only what PHPUnit needs, never what needs PHPUnit. Each moves inside its own composer.json constraint. When no release a direct dependency's constraint allows can sit next to the next PHPUnit major, plan holds PHPUnit at the last major that fits and names the package to raise (acme/phpstan-ext ^1.0 holds PHPUnit at 11: ...); with --to-phpunit the step stays, with a warning. Laravel plans keep their PHPUnit target, since the Laravel hops move the test stack.

A PHP hop raises a dependency when the gate proves it must. When the gate (the tests, or the replay's answers and PHP error log) fails in a file under vendor/<vendor>/<package>/, and that package is a direct dependency already on the newest release its constraint allows, while a newer major installs on the new PHP, Booster widens the constraint to <old> || ^<next>, runs composer update -W <package> and runs the whole gate again. If that gate passes, the step passes with a MANUAL: line that names the package, both majors and the release's source or docs link from Packagist, so the new major gets its review. If it still fails, composer.json and composer.lock go back to what the first gate left and the step stops as before, saying what was tried. A hop raises at most one package, and never laravel/framework, cakephp/cakephp, slim/slim or phpunit/phpunit, which their own hops move. --no-package-check turns the raise off. On the public slim-skeleton 4.5.0 it moves php-di/php-di ^6.4 to ^6.4 || ^7 at PHP 8.4, where 6.4.0's implicitly nullable parameters turn GET / into a 500.

typescript-major raises the npm packages in typescript_companion_pins when the app lists an older release: today prettier-plugin-organize-imports to ^4.2, the first release whose peer range accepts vue-tsc 3. Without it, npm only warns during the hop and the next npm install refuses the tree.

inertia-2-to-3 runs npm install (the lock still names Inertia 2, so npm ci would refuse it), then the build gate (npm ci, npm run build), then the composer gate. --skip-gate skips both gates; the install still runs.
